Description of Requirement: 

The 436th Aerial Port Squadron (436 APS) and the Joint Personal Property Shipping Office-Northeast (JPPSO-NE) at Dover Air Force Base (AFB), Delaware requires services for the preparation of the personal property (including servicing of appliances) of Department of Defense (DoD) personnel at Zones 11 and 12 for shipment, drayage, and/or storage and related services through the Direct Procurement Method (DPM).

Please see the attached PWS/SOW for a more in-depth overview of the requirement.

Codes for Services or Supplies:

NAICS: 488991 Packing and Crating

PSC:  V003 Transportation/Travel/Relocation – Motor Pool and Packing/Crating: Packing/Crating

Questions: In your response, please provide the following information:

  1. Is your company a large or small business?
  2. If applicable, indicate a best NAICS code for this acquisition not listed above.
  3. If applicable, what is your company’s socioeconomic status?
